rationale: The agent canceled the entire order immediately without first confirming the change with the user, violating the requirement to confirm every order-changing action before taking it. Authentication is not shown beyond looking up by email; no explicit verification step is evident. Ownership of the order was not verified prior to acting. The agent also provided refund amount, destination, and timeline without tool-result evidence shown. Even if the user was open to full cancellation, the policy still requires confirmation before executing writes. Therefore, the interaction does not meet the stated policy and fails.
